card.name: Dialysis removal statements in overdose text
card.fires_on: Words right after a drug name in overdose or renal sentences about whether dialysis or urinary excretion removes the drug, such as 'is only <<slightly>>' or 'is unlikely to be removed'. Also fires on spaces and word pieces in chemistry crystal text.

modes.label: Dialysis and excretion
modes.description: Words after a drug name in a sentence about removal by dialysis, protein binding or urine excretion.
modes.example: Bosentan<< is>> unlikely to be effectively removed by dialysis

modes.label: Crystal chemistry
modes.description: Spaces before numbers in chemistry text about crystals and synthesis.

card.writes: The promoted tokens suggest words about dissolving and extraction, but the effect is unclear.
